description: This plot, titled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate,” illustrates the maximum activation values across layers for four components—atten_output (blue dashed line), ffnn_output (green dashed line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), and ffnn_residual (red solid line)—in a baseline model configuration. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 20 with linear scaling and tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 400 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 50. The blue dashed line (atten_output) remains near zero until layer 5, then rises sharply after layer 10, peaking near 350 at layer 20. The green dashed line (ffn_output) follows a similar trend but remains consistently below the blue line, peaking near 200 at layer 20. The orange dotted line (atten_residual) stays near zero until layer 10, then rises to approximately 100 at layer 20. The red solid line (ffn_residual) begins near zero, rises gradually to about 100 at layer 10, and then increases sharply to approximately 350 at layer 20. All lines exhibit a steep increase in activation values after layer 10, with the red line reaching the highest values.
